text: Cobalt Harbor performed an offline monitoring coverage review for handoff evidence log jsonl s003372 on 2026-07-14. The evidence question was: What decision can be made from the retained source material without external access? The detection owner assembled the source facts; the telemetry reviewer tested their evidence quality. The review relates AC-27 to evidence set 184 and records RISK-031 as the governing risk reference. Dependency context: no upstream dependency. The source record is p03-src-003372 and this artifact is p03-full-003372. The evidence instrument was the meeting decision minute; the reviewer observed that the rationale accounted for an incomplete sample. During challenge, a single reviewer conclusion was checked for independent challenge. Review profile: the evidence set was collected before the approval meeting; the accountable owner confirmed the operating boundary; the reviewer sampled an adverse operating condition; the source fact supported acceptance with a documented caveat; the comparison used the prior review conclusion; the evidence was retained with the decision record; the exception path was not invoked; the reviewer found no handover impact; the decision was suitable for targeted follow-up; the source chronology was complete; the control claim was corroborated by a compensating observation; the review boundary identified unavailable material as a limitation; the next assurance trigger is the scheduled review; the disposition was communicated to the owner; the retained rationale supports repeat review; the record remains a local offline assurance artifact. Counterexample considered: A dependency reference is not meaningful unless the receiving artifact explains why it was consulted. Decision rule: Record an approval only after the reviewer can reproduce the conclusion from the retained facts without network access. Disposition: accepted with a retained review note. No Kio capability is used or required for this offline review.
